summary.name: VirtualBox
summary.one_liner: VirtualBox is a general-purpose full virtualization software from Oracle for running virtual machines on x86_64 hardware, aimed at laptops, desktops, servers and embedded use.
use_cases: run another operating system inside a window
test software on different operating systems
set up virtual servers on desktop or laptop
learn operating systems with tutorials and labs
run Windows or Linux guests on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: VirtualBox is a general-purpose full virtualization product for x86_64 hardware, targeted at laptop, desktop, server and embedded use. According to the page, version 7.1 adds support for macOS/Arm and version 7.2 adds Windows/Arm. The site links to user manuals, technical documentation, source code repository timeline, changelog, community forums and test builds. It also lists tutorials, videos and quizzes for learning the software. Release notes list maintenance updates to the 7.x line, such as 7.2.22 released October 20th, 2026.
notable: Community effort backed by Oracle, with Oracle providing quality criteria and support resources
macOS/Arm support added in version 7.1 and Windows/Arm in version 7.2
Includes user manuals, changelog, source code timeline and community forums
caveats: Arm support is limited to specific versions: macOS/Arm from 7.1 and Windows/Arm from 7.2, per the page
The page does not state explicit pricing terms; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware
